Batch updates personal, organizational, skills, insurance, or education sections.

Each section delegates mutation to its own dedicated database table.

Writes strictly to employee_profiles and users tables.

Update organizational details (department, role, employeeId, joinDate, manager, workLocation, subordinates).

Writes strictly to employee_organizational_profiles table.
